name: Loreal Studio Anti-Hair Fall Hair Wax 150ml Hard Wax for Hair for Men | France
description:
Loreal Studio Anti-Hair Fall Hair Wax – 150ml (Hard Wax for Men)

Product Type: Hair Gel / Wax

Capacity: 150ml

For: Men (All hair types, can also be used by women)

Benefits:

Provides light hold for natural-looking hairstyles

Adds shine with a healthy, glossy finish

Moisturizes and conditions hair for soft, nourished feel

Key Ingredients: Mineral oil, Petrolatum

Scent: Classic, refreshing fragrance

Usage: Easy to apply on wet or dry hair, perfect for everyday styling

Made In: France

Imported From: UAE
